page_inventory.architecture_overview: Multi-tenant page. Root index.tsx is a thin PARTNER ROUTER: PARTNER_VIEWS maps canonical L1 firmIds ('49financial' | 'inflection' | 'cottonwood' | 'demo', from firmAccess.ts) to per-tenant view components under _partners/. Internal/dev users get a firm selector over ALL_PARTNER_FIRMS; external users are pinned to claims.firmId. Default + fallback view: 49financial. All shared rendering lives under _shared/ (tabs, panels, charts, components, lib, hooks, types); per-tenant divergence is expressed through _partners/{firm}/layout.ts TenantLayoutConfig objects read via the useTenantLayout() hook — NOT through firmId === '...' conditionals in components.
